pages.text: Every natural creature now carries a gene: forty new ones, eighty-nine in all. Each belongs to its creature's department, and the Splicer sorts them that way: a row's chip steps through the departments with a usable gene, the arrows through its genes. The cost is printed in grey on the cassette.

Each gene below is named with its load and its cost. Load 1 to 3 fits a body, a host and a mecha; load 4 only a host and a Gene Port. Numbers work at 70%% in bodies and hosts. Food, bows, trades and armour work for people only: a host or a mecha has no stomach for them.
$(l)Livestock$()$(br)$(item)Ruminant Gut$() 1: you moo when hurt.$(br)$(item)Stew Glands$() 2: stews fill half, and a wither rose withers you.$(br)$(item)Swine Appetite$() 1: you oink at every bite.

$(item)Fleece$() 2: fleeced, fire burns longer and 25%% harder.$(br)$(item)Mountain Hooves$() 2: hooves take no boots.$(br)$(l)Field Office$()$(br)$(item)Bamboo Diet$() 1: you sit down to eat.$(br)$(item)Snow Pounce$() 3: by day under open sky, the cooldown is 8 s.

$(item)Pollinator$() 2: 20%% slower in the rain.$(br)$(item)Roll Up$() 3: curled, you cannot move, hit or use anything.$(br)$(item)Keen Nose$() 1: you sneeze near flowers.$(br)$(item)Mimicry$() 1: cookies poison you.$(br)$(item)Tongue$() 3: you croak when you jump.

$(item)Tadpole Tail$() 1: none. It is a tadpole.$(br)$(l)Logistics$()$(br)$(item)Spit Gland$() 2: stand in front of you for 5 s and get spat at.$(br)$(item)Pearl Digestion$() 2: endermen attack you on sight.

$(item)Levitation Bolt$() 4: a mecha takes 10%% of its heat limit a shot.$(br)$(item)Fetch$() 2: near a playing jukebox, you dance instead of attacking.$(br)$(l)Security$()$(br)$(item)Arctic Coat$() 2: heat and the Nether slow you and make you hungry.$(br)$(l)Night Shift$()

$(item)Undeath$() 3: bare-headed, daylight burns you. Smite hurts.$(br)$(item)Sun-Baked$() 2: 30 s in water slows you for a minute.$(br)$(item)Rehabilitated$() 2: golden apples sicken you. Hit a villager: suspended a day.

$(item)Gilded Rot$() 2: gold armour wears out twice as fast.$(br)$(item)Rampage$() 3: on a streak you take 15%% more damage and cannot sneak.$(br)$(item)Bowstring Arms$() 2: wild wolves hunt you.$(br)$(item)Rime Arrows$() 2: fire burns you 20%% harder.

$(item)Spore Arrows$() 2: poison on you lasts 50%% longer.$(br)$(item)Undertow Stride$() 2: you sink, and swim up half as fast.$(br)$(l)Facilities$()$(br)$(item)Snow Trail$() 2: you melt in hot places, the Nether and the rain.

$(item)Weeping Glands$() 4: it sobs every few minutes, and fogs a mecha's glass.$(br)$(item)Stone Lungs$() 2: one stone block in a hundred lets out a silverfish.$(br)$(l)Accounts$()$(br)$(item)Gold Standard$() 2: gold in sight on the ground slows you 10%%.

$(item)Brute Strength$() 3: piglins attack you, gold or no gold, and never barter.$(br)$(l)Legal$()$(br)$(item)Phase$() 4: each phase takes 2 health from a host, 3%% from a mecha.$(br)$(item)Breaking and Entering$() 2: villagers will not trade while you hold an axe.
$(item)Steady Aim$() 2: bows draw 20%% slower.$(br)$(item)Fang Line$() 4: blue sheep nearby turn red. Mecha: 15%% of its heat limit.$(br)$(item)Potion Tolerance$() 3: milk does nothing for you.

$(item)Bulldoze$() 4: you trample everything, your own farm included.$(br)$(l)Sales$()$(br)$(item)Dusk Draught$() 2: at dawn you drink any milk you carry: every effect goes.$(br)$(l)Marine Division$()$(br)$(item)Puffer$() 2: puffed, you are 30%% slower and cannot sprint.$(br2)$(o)HR apologises to the cow.$()
